figures.title: Target selection across recorded episodes
figures.caption: Recorded target-selection contrast: verified demonstration episode 50 and failed rollout episode 0. The instruction asks for the plush; the verified demonstration moves the plush toward the box, whereas the illustrated failed rollout transports the red cube. Each block shows front RGB above the spatial attention of the same wrist query S06. Frames were chosen by inspecting visible interactions, at the timestamps shown; they are not matched initial states. All maps use the same attention/uniform scale. This illustrates that query identity and language conditioning do not guarantee object-category-consistent spatial pooling. It does not establish that this query caused the wrong-object action. Demonstrations are recorded training examples, not closed-loop successes measured in this analysis.

figures.title: Concentrated, diffuse and overlapping pooling
